newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Van Lanschot "click fund" raises 320 mln guilders.
newsitem.headline: Van Lanschot "click fund" raises 320 mln guilders.

text.p: Dutch bank Van Lanschot said on Friday it had raised 320 million guilders with its latest "click fund" and had invested those funds in the market.

The Index Click Fund invests in a basket of shares which reflects the composition and weighting of Amsterdam's main AEX share index, and has "clicks" which lock in capital gains at levels of 30, 50 and 70 percent.

The fund uses an options cocktail to ensure that these profits are retained, even if the market subseqently falls. The fund also limits an investor's downside risk to some three percent over the five-year investment period, Van Lanschot said.
The new fund's 3.9 million shares have been listed on the Amsterdam stock exchange since January 23.
